name: marm-memory
description: Local-first 3-in-1 AI memory layer & MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini, VS Code and Cursor. Fuses session history, codebase indexing & concept graphs in SQLite. Enables zero-cloud, privacy-first context & instant recall, supports multi-agent swarms.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: ores if a single keyword match should not count as a perfect one.
capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: rofile swarm (200 RPM) or --profile swarm-max (600 RPM).
capability_evidence.memory-context: local control plane for memory, graphs, code context, distillation, runtime controls, and the integrated terminal.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: antic lane; set MARMRECALLREFERENCETIME on the server so two runs rank near-ties identically.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: marm-memory v2.59.3 - Give your AI Agents a permanent memory in 60 seconds
capability_evidence.security-isolation: a permanent, graph-linked doc action="add"\ "use"\ "show"\ "status"\ "clear"\ "save", name, data, sessionname, project, platform
capability_evidence.self-hosted: rvice (embedded SQLite) Vector DB (Qdrant/pgvector) Postgres + vector DB Neo4j Separate iii-engine runtime
capability_evidence.notifications: ne runs as a supervised child process, not an import:
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Copilot

analysis.summary_en: alt="marm-memory - persistent local memory server for AI agents (Model Context Protocol)"
highlights: Concurrent recall: 10 gathered recalls completed in 151.5ms vs 176.0ms serial (gather/serial = 0.86).
Both HTTP and STDIO expose 16 tools: 8 core memory/logging/notebook/compaction tools, 6 bundled code-graph tools, and 2 concept-graph tools
Layered recall depth: detail=1 returns a short summary view (~200 chars), detail=2 a larger context view (~500 chars), detail=3 full memory content
Verify port 8001 isn't in use: lsof -i :8001 (macOS/Linux) or netstat -ano | findstr :8001 (Windows)
